title: Pediatric ECG foundation model via adult-to-pediatric fine-tuning: downstream tasks and clinical evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07717v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pediatric electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation is complicated by age-dependent electrophysiological changes that limit direct transfer of adult AI models. We asked whether an adult ECG foundation model could be adapted to pediatric ECGs. Using 339,563 12-lead ECGs from 238,189 children, we compared direct application, pediatric fine-tuning, and training from scratch under an identical architecture. Direct transfer was poor (mean AUC 0.8256). Fine-tuning reached 0.9695, above de novo training (0.9661), and attained 0.9079 using only 1% of training data. On 10,999 external ECGs, fine-tuning achieved a mean AUC of 0.9385 across 30 labels. It generalized to age regression (MAE 1.12 years) and congenital heart disease classification (AUC 0.9562). Across 17 clinicians and 100 cases, diagnostic accuracy rose from 56.8% to 65.4% (p < 0.001) and did not decline when AI erred. Adult ECG foundation models require pediatric adaptation; fine-tuning

translated_title: 基于成人到儿科微调的儿科心电图基础模型：下游任务与临床评估
translated_abstract: 儿科心电图（ECG）解读因年龄依赖性电生理变化而变得复杂，这限制了成人AI模型的直接迁移。我们探究了成人ECG基础模型能否适配到儿科心电图。我们使用来自238,189名儿童的339,563份12导联心电图，在相同架构下比较了直接应用、儿科微调和从头训练三种方法。直接迁移效果较差（平均AUC 0.8256）。微调后达到0.9695，高于从头训练（0.9661），且仅使用1%的训练数据即可达到0.9079。在10,999份外部心电图上，微调模型在30个标签上的平均AUC达到0.9385。该模型还能泛化至年龄回归任务（MAE 1.12岁）和先天性心脏病分类（AUC 0.9562）。在涉及17名临床医生和100个病例的评估中，诊断准确率从56.8%提升至65.4%（p < 0.001），且当AI出错时医生准确率并未下降。成人ECG基础模型需要进行儿科适配；微调
tldr: 该研究证明成人心电图基础模型经儿科数据微调后性能可超越从头训练，具备良好的外部泛化能力和下游任务扩展性，并能显著提升临床医生的诊断准确率。
en_tdlr: Fine-tuning an adult ECG foundation model on pediatric data outperforms training from scratch, generalizes well to external validation and downstream tasks, and significantly improves clinicians' diagnostic accuracy.
